body.message:
If you would like to secure and block the unit for a period of 6 months, the first and last month’s rent would need to be paid in advance.

Alternatively, you may proceed with monthly extensions, subject to the availability of the unit. Please note that the property is listed on multiple booking platforms, so we may receive a confirmed booking at any time.

For this reason, we are unable to guarantee availability for future monthly extensions unless the unit is secured in advance.

Thank you for your understanding
